title: Detecting Natural Wolbachia Infection and Supergroup Identification of Metochus uniguttatus in North India
author: Anuradha Sameer, Joshi
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Collect insects and preserve
steps.instruction: Capture insects in the field manually using netting and gloves, then immediately place each specimen into absolute ethanol to immobilize and preserve it.

steps.title: Extract genomic DNA
steps.instruction: Isolate DNA from each ethanol‑preserved insect using the phenol‑chloroform‑isoamyl alcohol extraction method.

steps.title: Amplify CO1 for species ID
steps.instruction: Perform PCR amplification of the mitochondrial CO1 gene to identify the insect species.

steps.title: Screen for Wolbachia by PCR
steps.instruction: Use PCR to amplify the Wolbachia‑specific 16S Wspec DNA fragment to detect Wolbachia infection.

steps.title: Sanger sequence amplicons
steps.instruction: Send the CO1 PCR products and any positive Wspec PCR products for Sanger sequencing.

steps.title: Analyze sequence data
steps.instruction: Compare the obtained sequences to NCBI databases using BLAST, align the FASTA files with Sequencher 5.4.6, and examine chromatograms to verify contig quality and similarity.
